header.running_head: The Da'wah Rasulullaah ﷺ Gave to Pairs

blocks.text: Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) then said, "Have you finished, O Muhammad?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "Yes" and then dismounted the donkey. When Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) mounted it again, Hind turned to Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) and said, "Did you make my son dismount for that magician?" Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) replied, "I swear by Allaah that he is neither a magician nor a liar." [^1]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Invites Hadhrat Talha (RA) and Hadhrat Zubayr (RA) to Islaam

Hadhrat Yazeed bin Roomaan narrates that Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) and Hadhrat Talha (RA) followed Hadhrat Zubayr (RA) to Rasulullaah ﷺ. When the two (Hadhrat Talha (RA) and Hadhrat Zubayr (RA)) came to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he presented Islaam to them, recited the Qur'aan to them, informed them about the rights of Islaam and promised them Allaah's munificence. Both of them accepted Islaam and acknowledged the message.
Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) then said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! I have just arrived from Shaam. When we were between Ma'aan and Zarqaa, we fell into a slumber and then heard a caller announcing, 'O you sleeping ones! Get up because Ahmad had appeared in Makkah. We then heard of you when we reached." Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) was among the first to accept Islaam even before Rasulullaah ﷺ started coming to the house of Arqam. [^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Invites Hadhrat Ammaar (RA) and Hadhrat Suhayb (RA) to Islaam

Hadhrat Amaar bin Yaasir (RA) narrates, "I met Suhayb bin Sanaan (RA) at the door of Arqam's house. I asked him, 'What are you doing here?' He asked me, 'What are you doing here?' I replied, 'I want to meet Muhammad and hear what he has to say.' He then said, 'I have the same intention.' We entered the house and met Rasulullaah ﷺ. He presented Islaam to us and we both accepted. We then stayed there the entire day until the evening when we secretly left."
Hadhrat Amaar bin Yaasir (RA) and Hadhrat Suhayb (RA) accepted Islaam after thirty odd people had already accepted. May Allaah be pleased with all of them. [^3]
